Name: Beach Farm Mobile Version
Author: WisnuNug
Description:
This turn farm beach from update 1.5 to mobile version with small change area.

NOTE: PLEASE READ IN.

1. This mod is not compatible with the any mod texture change of the greenhouse and any expanded greenhouse. So please disable any mods related to the greenhouse.

2. Do not use warp totem items to farm.

3. The Greenhouse will not display the original building texture, if it is the first time you start the game. Greenhouse looks like it's been built but actually it's not.

I only upload this mod on Nexus, so don't download it on other sites.

Requirements:
Stardew Valley v1.4.5.151
Smapi Android Latest Version
Content Patcher
Device

Thanks you.
